conflicts.permit: We and service providers, which only use your data on our behalf, will collect any information that you choose to provide directly through our Services, including your name, email address, postal address, telephone number, password, age, payment card information, country of residence, communications and content preferences, travel-related information and your favorite Member stations.
conflicts.prohibit: If you wish to make a payment or receive a refund through our Services, your information will be collected and controlled by the payment processor and not by us and will be subject to that payment service provider's privacy policy and practices.
conflicts.situation: A user enters payment card information to buy from the NPR Shop or make a donation through the NPR Services.
conflicts.reason: One statement says NPR and its service providers collect payment card information; the other says payment information is collected and controlled by the processor, not NPR. No exception or precedence separates them.

conflicts.permit: We may disclose your information to our parent companies in connection with operating our business.
conflicts.prohibit: When Vimeo collects, stores and processes that information, it does so solely on behalf of the applicable Producer and at its direction to, among other things, allow the Producer to provide you with the applicable Producer Channel.
conflicts.situation: Vimeo holds a consumer's account registration information, such as name and email, and discloses it to its parent companies for operating Vimeo's business.
conflicts.reason: One statement limits Vimeo's processing of account information to the Producer's behalf and direction. The other permits disclosure to Vimeo's parents for Vimeo's own business. The policy states no exception or precedence.

conflicts.permit: We may collect personal identification information from Users in a variety of ways, including, but not limited to, when Users visit our site, register on the site, place an order, subscribe to the newsletter, respond to a survey, fill out a form, and in connection with other activities, services, features or resources we make available on our Site.
conflicts.prohibit: We will collect personal identification information from Users only if they voluntarily submit such information to us.
conflicts.situation: A user browses the Site without registering, ordering, subscribing, or filling out any form.
conflicts.reason: The first statement lists a site visit itself as an occasion for collecting personal identification information. The second limits collection to voluntary submission. The policy does not say whether a visit involves only voluntary submission.
